displayName: inflect agent proposals are FLOODING the review queue (#3856)

conditions.displayName: more than 50 proposals created in the last hour
proposal-volume reporting stopped — absence is not health

documentation.content:
Agent proposals were created at more than 50 an hour. The review queue is
filling faster than a human can read it.

WHY VOLUME IS THE SIGNAL. The queue's entire value is that a person looked
before anything took effect. A queue that fills with plausible noise does not
fail loudly -- reviewers start approving by habit, and the control degrades into
a rubber stamp while every dashboard stays green. That is strictly worse than an
outage, because the outcome is approved records nobody really examined.

WHAT IT COUNTS. Every `AgentProposal` row created in the last hour, across all
tenants and all four proposal kinds -- not only the assistant's. That is
deliberate: a reviewer's queue does not care which producer filled it, and
scoping this to one producer would miss the case where two of them each stay
under their own threshold.

WHAT TO DO.

    journalctl -u assistant-health-reporter.service -n 50

Then look at the queue itself at `/t/<slug>/agents/proposals`, sorted newest
first, and ask whether the proposals are DISTINCT. Many near-identical
proposals point at a loop or a retried run; many varied but thin ones point at a
model proposing on weak evidence.

Worth checking alongside: `assistant_turns`. Proposal volume rising while turns
stay flat means more proposals per turn, which is a model-behaviour change. Both
rising together is just more use, and the threshold may simply need raising --
in which case raise it HERE, in the repo copy, rather than on the VM.

THE THRESHOLD IS A STARTING POINT, not a measurement. Production proposal
volume has never been high enough to characterise, so this is set just above
what one busy tenant could plausibly generate. The first time it fires, read the
queue before assuming the alert is wrong -- and if it is wrong, say what the
observed normal was in the commit that changes it.
